quests.title: Pick the theme
quests.answer: Doing the right thing the wrong way. Each generation is right about the danger and wrong about the method.

quests.title: Set the tone
quests.answer: Light-hearted on the surface, serious underneath. The Avatar model. Characters joke, the world doesn't.

quests.title: Choose the gimmick
quests.answer: Awakening, our Mega Evolution. 12 species in this region. Needs the species' stone plus a deep bond. One per battle. Not legendaries.

quests.title: Explain where the power comes from
quests.answer: The Current: elemental energy moves like water. Sources, land, creatures, release. Types come from biomes; evolution is the body growing to hold more.

quests.title: Make the backstory hold up
quests.answer: A century ago the ancestor forced creatures to hold the surge, out of desperation. An island was lost. The elders banned awakening; keepers gather the stones.

quests.title: Choose the hook
quests.answer: A stranger, the heir, arrives at the gate, is refused, and that night steals the town's stones, the record, and one rescue.

quests.title: Fix the professor problem
quests.answer: The warden runs a rescue station. The starters are rescues waiting to go home. You carry yours home along the route.

quests.title: Make the 12 non-legendary
quests.answer: The 12 are ordinary species. Anyone bonded can awaken one. Keepers' stones are the badges. No separate bag.

quests.title: Give the rival a reason
quests.answer: The warden's kid. Guilt over the theft, tempted by the heir mid-game, comes back. (Default)

quests.title: Decide how light the heir's crew is
quests.answer: Mostly earnest islanders, plus a comic duo who switch sides. (Default)

quests.title: Decide how travel works
quests.answer: The sea is the overworld, your boat the traversal. Fixed story islands with open tiers between, any order. Keepers scale to stones held. (Default)

quests.title: Confirm the Defaults in 11-story.md
quests.prompt: Read every item marked Default in 11-story.md. Keep it, change it, or flag it. Write what you changed.

everything else is good

- Tone rules (Default) › *Show the serious side, don't announce it. A keeper who guards a stone and can't remembe…*: **Note**. Very important we show rather than tell. Story-telling 101
- Tone rules (Default) › *The seriousness lands through creatures. The stolen starter's forced form is the moment…*: **Change**. Shouln't be stop smiling forever of course. its a moment to take it in but darker tones should be understood from the jump but not pushed you know. Like the real world. Thats just how things are.
- Tone rules (Default) › *Nobody is evil for fun. The heir is grieving and certain. His crew believe him.*: **Change**. Sometimes there are just assholes.
